Evidence stream: Global plastic mass (Geyer et al., 2017; Jambeck et al., 2015; Cook et al., 2025)
What it cannot support: A neighbourhood, resin, or plant assignment
Transfer condition: Local measurement of the object to be moved

Evidence stream: Circular-economy constructs (Kirchherr et al., 2017; Geissdoerfer et al., 2017; Hossain et al., 2022)
What it measures: Circularity as an umbrella; source-specific recovery as the Indian weakness
What it can support: Policy framing; identification of a recovery gap
What it cannot support: A Delhi NCT locality at which EPR can be audited
Transfer condition: Capture measurement at the named site

Evidence stream: Composition surveys (CPCB, 2015; Directorate of Environment, NCT of Delhi, 2019; CPCB, 2024)
What it measures: Resin prevalence by city or area type

Evidence stream: Spatial association (Anselin, 1995; Getis & Ord, 1992; Kumar, Choudhary & Mathur, 2026)
Transfer condition: Local statistic at the decision unit

Evidence stream: City processing ledgers (Sharholy et al., 2008; Talyan et al., 2008; Delhi Economic Survey, 2026)
What it cannot support: Plant capacity or a named bottleneck

Evidence stream: WTE / plant operations (DPCC, 2025; Astrup et al., 2015; Hindustan Times CPCB affidavit, 2026)
What it can support: Candidate sink; blocked node; operational relief

Evidence stream: Rank robustness (Belton & Stewart, 2002; Saltelli et al., 2008)
What it measures: Stability of a priority ordering under specification change
What it cannot support: A guaranteed programme from an untested list

Evidence stream: Reverse logistics (Fleischmann et al., 1997; Govindan et al., 2015; Das & Bhattacharyya, 2015)
What it measures: Origins, sinks, and capacities as constraints
What it can support: A feasibility file for later routing
Transfer condition: Observed roads, fleet, time windows, costs
